svg.title: Roll out the two service extensions
svg.desc: Do not declare success while identity policy is in dry run or content inspection is bypassed. An allowed benign control and a denied adversarial control are both required.

g.text: Roll out the two service extensions
Do not declare success while identity policy is in dry run or content inspection is bypassed.
Register destinations, create gateway in DRY_RUN, and bind agent (05–07)
Capture the full agent principal and verify the MCP toolspec and A2A agent card.
Grant named read tools (IAP), Cloud Run invoker, and Google API roles (08)
One principal, explicit tool names + readOnlyHint, and 17 platform endpoints.
Flip IAP REQUEST_AUTHZ (08) + attach Model Armor CONTENT_AUTHZ (09)
Disable dry run. Keep failOpen false. Grant serviceExtensionsServiceAccount.
Run the 7-beat acceptance suite and verify gateway logs (10-demo.sh)
Read / wrong panel / direct + indirect injection / write block / whoami / gateway_log.py.
An allowed benign control and a denied adversarial control are both required.
